RRB JE CBT 1 Result 2026 Out

A total of 574402 candidates appeared for the RRB JE CBT 1 Exam conducted on 19th, 20th and 25th February in three shifts at 200+ exam centres. Is the RRB JE CBT 1 Result Out? Yes, the RRB JE CBT 1 Result 2026 has been uploaded on 13th May at the official website https://www.rrbcdg.gov.in/. Along with result, the authority also released the zone wise cut off marks, scorecard, merit list pdf. All the candidates who have cleared the CBT 1 Stage, are now provisionally selected for the next stage, that is CBT 2. The RRB JE CBT 2 Exam 2026 will be conducted on 2nd July 2026.

Currently, the recruitment is in its 1st Stage, as the RRB JE Scorecard 2025-26 has been uploaded at the official website rrb.digialm.com.  The table below discusses the facts regarding the current recruitment year and the status of the RRB JE Result.

Steps to Check the RRB JE CBT 1 Result 2026

Step 1: Visit to the official website of Railway Recruitment Board, RRB rrbcdg.gov.in.

Step 2: Go to the tab named “Result of CBT 1 for JE/DMS/CMA (CEN 05/2025).”

Step 3: Click on the link to open the RRB JE CBT 1 Merit List PDF in the browser.

Step 4: Press ‘Ctrl+F’ & enter the roll number of the candidates to see if you are selected or not.

Step 5: Go to the section of”Scorecard Login” on the homepage.

Step 6: Enter the Registration Number & Password (DOB) correctly

Step 7: Download & print the RRB JE Result for future reference

RRB JE CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 Link Active

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has activated the RRB JE CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 link for candidates who appeared in the Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) examination conducted under CEN 05/2025. Candidates can now check their normalized marks, raw scores, percentile, and qualifying status by logging in with their Registration Number and Date of Birth on the official regional RRB websites. The direct link to download the RRB JE CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 PDF has been shared below.

What After RRB JE CBT 1 Result 2026?

After the declaration of the RRB JE Result, successful candidates must gear up for CBT 2. The stage is much more competitive as it tests candidates on a difficulty level with questions. Depending on the post, candidates may also have to clear a Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) or a Typing Skill Test.

  1. CBT 2 Preparation: Candidates should focus on the speed & accuracy for the paper
  2. Skill Test: Practice typing or aptitude tests if required for the post
  3. Document Verification: Keep all original Graduate degrees & category certificates ready.
  4. Medical Exam: See that the candidates meet the A-2 or B-2 medical standards as per the job needs.

RRB JE CBT 2 Exam Date 2026

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has officially announced the exact RRB JE CBT 2 Exam Date 2026 for candidates shortlisted under CEN 05/2025. As per the notice, the RRB JE CBT 2 Exam 2026 will be held in 2nd July 2026.

Student’s Queries on RRB JE CBT 1 Result 2026

Q1. When will the RRB JE Result 2026 be out?

Ans: The RRB JE Result for CBT 1 has been released on 13th May at the regional websites.

Q2. How is the RRB JE CBT 1 cut off calculated?

Ans: The cut off is calculated on the total vacancies per zone, the number of candidates who appeared and the difficulty level of the shifts.

Q3. Where can the candidates download the RRB JE CBT 1 Scorecard?

Ans: Candidates can download the RRB JE CBT 1 Scorecard by logging into the section”CEN 05/2025″ of rrbapply.gov.in with the registration ID properly.

Q4. Is there a separate result for DMS/CMA?

Ans: No there is a common RRB JE Result for all Graduate posts in CBT 1. Post-specific shortlisting happens during the CBT 2 & Aptitude Test stages of the candidates.
